application_json_key_case_scope: tool-defined result and argument payloads (e.g. RegisterTyped-derived schemas, structuredContent)
protocol_envelope_key_case_note: The MCP JSON-RPC envelope itself (jsonrpc, id, method, params, and hint fields like readOnlyHint) follows the MCP specification, which is camelCase and is not a Symaira convention to change.
stdout_pollution_rule: A tool exposing an MCP server over stdio must write only structured JSON-RPC frames to stdout; logs, diagnostics, and warnings go to stderr.
transport_framing: Content-Length header followed by CRLFCRLF and the JSON-RPC body, per the MCP stdio transport spec.
